verdict.rationale: All evidence describes consumer-facing Gemini Apps UI features (Deep Research, Gems, scheduled actions, Connected Apps, Gemini Live, Notebooks, image generation) with no documentation that these same capabilities are exposed via the Gemini API; the probe evidence explicitly notes the developer API on ai.google.dev is a separate product from the Gemini app and that the app exposes no agent-docs or API-discovery surface, indicating the opposite of UI/API parity rather than confirming it.
